one_liner: Space Force analyst in Dahlgren who tracks satellites and orbital debris, computes precise orbits from sensor data, and briefs military leaders on space objects.
fit_summary: This is a highly technical operations role that calls for expert knowledge of orbital mechanics, precision orbit determination, and space sensor data analysis. Daniel's strengths are policy, public engagement, and emergency-management consulting, and nothing on file shows technical space or operations research experience. Daniel's policy knowledge and coordination skills help only at the margins.
eligibility: Open to the public under Direct Hire, so you do not need federal status; you apply through the posting's Direct Hire link.
You must be able to obtain and keep a Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility and access to Special Access Programs (SAP), and sign a non-disclosure agreement.

Qualifying is based on OPM's 0301 Administrative and Management experience standards at the GS-12/13 equivalent level, which typically means at least a year of experience at about the next-lower level.
This is a Testing Designated Position, so you will be subject to random drug testing.
strategy: Apply only if you have real quantitative, orbital, or sensor-analysis experience the file doesn't show. Otherwise, put your effort into policy, emergency-management, or legislative roles that fit better.

If you apply, describe your IEM work in 0301 terms: analyzing data for government clients, coordinating across agencies, and briefing senior officials. State hours per week and dates briefly, and keep the resume to two pages.
Highlight any work at IEM on DoD or national-level policy and doctrine, along with any experience handling sensitive information.
Do not overstate technical skills; clearance investigators and technical interviewers will check them.
The window is short (Oct 27 to Nov 3, 2026), so have your resume ready before it opens and submit early through the Direct Hire link.
resume_bullets: [Title], IEM, [MM/YYYY–MM/YYYY], [hours]/week: Analyzed [type of data] for [government client] and presented findings and recommendations to [senior officials].
Coordinated with [number] federal, state, and local organizations on [preparedness/recovery project], prioritizing tasks and tracking progress to meet [deliverable/deadline].
Interpreted [federal policy/doctrine, e.g., Stafford Act or FEMA guidance] to shape [plan or product] for [client].
interview_questions: Walk us through how you would perform a manual differential correction on an orbit that isn't converging.
How do sensor limitations differ for Near-Earth and Deep-Space objects, and how do they affect tasking?
Tell us about a time you presented complex analysis to senior leadership under time pressure.
How have you protected sensitive or classified information in past work?
watch_outs: The role requires deep orbital mechanics and operations research expertise, which Daniel's background does not show.
You must be able to obtain a TS/SCI clearance with SAP access, which brings a long investigation and continuing obligations.
The job is in Dahlgren, roughly 1.5 hours from Manassas, and may involve overtime, military or commercial air travel, and work in a C2 center.
The application window is only one week.
